items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-kominka-thatched
reasons: Roof share 39.7% (top row 13 to outline row 43 = 31 rows / bbox 78), outside the 30-36% band.

Thatch grain sits in identical 2-row pairs across the full width every 4 rows (19-20, 23-24, 27-28, 31-32, 35-36). Rule 7 wants irregular strokes 3-5px apart; this reads as ruler rows, and there is no broken darker band-separator row.
The noren carries a white crest mark at rows 54-56, a glyph banned by rule 9.
The view passes: the top band runs from the ridge cap to a thick eave (bfb77f x2, #593e39, #452b2d, outline, wall shadow), and the front face reads cleanly at 1x in map 01.
fixes: Drop about 4-5 roof rows (for example from the thatch body) so the share lands near 33-34%.
Break up the grain: stagger the 1px x 2-row strokes 3-5px apart with varying row offsets, and add a broken darker row between the 4-row bands.
Remove the crest from the noren and leave it plain.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-kawara-farmhouse
reasons: Roof share 38.4% (rows 7-34 = 28 / bbox 73), outside the 30-36% band.
All 4 kawara courses (rows 16-17, 20-21, 24-25, 28-29) carry 4px vertical joints across the full width. Rule 4 allows joints only on the top 1-2 courses.

The other roof elements pass: the ridge box has the cream noshi row (row 10), hip triangles are present with a bright west line, and the eave sequence is correct (tip #8588ad, dark rows, outline at 34, shadow at 35).
The view passes at 1x in map 01.
fixes: Cut about 3 roof rows (one course) to reach about 33-35%.
Keep joints only on the top 1-2 courses. Strip joints from the lower courses and use sparse staggered 3px light marks about 44px apart.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-kura-storehouse
reasons: Roof share 33.8% passes.
All 3 courses (rows 18-19, 22-23, 26-27) are jointed every 4px. Rule 4 allows joints only on the top 1-2 courses.
The hip ends are a stepped trapezoid silhouette with no distinct triangle faces about 10px wide, no vertical 4px stripes, and no light-west/dark-east hip lines (rule 6).
The ridge box has onigawara at both ends, and the eave sequence is correct.
The view passes: the namako walls and plinth read as a front face in map 01.
fixes: Remove joints from the lowest course and use sparse staggered 3px marks about 44px apart.
Paint hip triangle faces at both ends (about 10px wide at the top) with vertical 4px stripes, a light hip line on the west and dark on the east, and the west face lighter than the east.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-dagashiya
reasons: Roof share 35.3% passes.
All 3 courses (rows 37-38, 41-42, 45-46) are jointed every 4px, violating rule 4.
There are no hip triangle faces or stripes at the roof ends (rule 6).
The onigawara and eave sequence are fine. The signboard has no text (it uses dots), and the striped awning is fabric, so it is exempt.
The view passes in map 02.
fixes: Keep joints on the top 1-2 courses only. Give the lower course sparse staggered 3px marks about 44px apart.
Add hip triangle end faces about 10px wide, with 4px vertical stripes and light-west/dark-east hip lines.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-wooden-station
reasons: Roof share 34.7% passes. Joints sit only on the top 2 courses, and the hip faces have stripes, so rules 4 and 6 are compliant.

The central front gable (board triangle with clock, rows 21-46) is pasted onto the roof plane with no roof slopes of its own. It runs below the eave outline row 44 at x≈34-74, which breaks the continuous #1a1226 eave outline and the tip/dark/outline/shadow eave sequence across about 40px (rules 2 and 3).

The full-width white band at rows 48-54 sticks out past the walls (x4-107). As a fascia or sign it is fine; if it is meant as a canopy it has no top surface. This is a minor view doubt and not charged.
At 1x in map 03 the building still reads as a 3/4 station.
fixes: Run the eave sequence and #1a1226 outline unbroken across the full width, and end the gable triangle above the eave.
Give the gable its own short roof slopes (bargeboards with tile edge) so it sits as a dormer-style gable, not a decal.
If the white band is a canopy, give it a 1-2 row top surface; otherwise keep it flush with the walls.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-bus-stop-shelter
reasons: Roof share 33.9% passes.
The tin ribs run on a 4px period over rows 3-18 (16 rows) with no 1-row darker seam. Rule 8 requires a seam every 12 rows.
The eave tip #e6e2f0 then #cac7d6 then outline is correct.
The dark diagonal zone at x≈27-34 reads as an east hip shadow at 1x in map 02, not a receding side face, so view charge 4 is not applied.
fixes: Insert a 1-row darker seam about 12 rows below the roof top (around row 14).

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-waterwheel-mill
reasons: Roof share 36.2% (rows 5-25 = 21 / bbox 58) is 1 row over the 36% cap.
The thatch grain uses the same regular 2-row pairs on every 4-row band (11-12, 15-16, 19-20), with no broken darker separator row (rule 7).
The thick thatch eave (bfb77f x2, #593e39, #452b2d, outline) and the dark ridge cap are fine. The flume, wheel and basin read correctly in front view, and the basin has a water top and a front face.
The view passes in map 04.
fixes: Trim one roof row, or extend the basin/plinth by one row, so the share is 36% or less (target about 34%).
Stagger the grain strokes irregularly 3-5px apart and add a broken darker row between bands.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-agri-tin-shed
reasons: Roof share 41.5% (rows 11-37 = 27 / bbox 65), well over 36%.
The ribs run on a 4px period over rows 12-34 (23 rows) with no 1-row darker seam every 12 rows (rule 8).
The white eave tip (#e6e2f0, #cac7d6, outline) is fine.
The dark band at x≈47-58 is the east hip shading: the silhouette steps inward at the top, which reads as a hipped roof, not an isometric side face.
The view passes in map 04.
fixes: Cut about 4-5 roof rows to reach about 34%.
Add 1-row darker seams at 12-row intervals across the ribs.

summary: Group A: 0/8 pass. The 3/4 view contract holds for all 8 (clear top band, front face, no side faces, reads correctly at 1x in maps 01-04), so no view charges 1-7 and no style 8a-8d charges were raised. Every candidate fails the binding roof_rules: roof share over 36% (kominka 39.7, kawara 38.4, tin shed 41.5, waterwheel 36.2); all kawara courses jointed (kawara, kura, dagashiya); no hip triangle faces (kura, dagashiya); regular thatch grain rows (kominka, waterwheel); no 12-row tin seam (bus stop, tin shed); the station gable breaks the eave outline; and a glyph on the kominka noren. Note: the anchors measured the same way sit at about 38-39% roof share, so the 30-36% band is stricter than the anchors. It was enforced as written. All fixes are local and small.
